unslop.name: unslop
unslop.integration: This is the actual UI Unslop skill by Damir Sokolovsky (https://github.com/heydamir/unslop), CC BY 4.0, with its unmodified reference files. Factory adaptation: the supplied brief and resolved per-page fidelity axes override generic style defaults; preserve the reference on matched axes, including intentional colors, fonts, weights, section order and effects. Follow the already-authorized unattended workflow. Use controlled factory_reference captures and factory_browser observations instead of the upstream host snapshot script. Read example images with factory_reference action design_pack, packId unslop, packFile references/refs/<filename>.webp; these are design-quality examples, not client assets. Write the output in the assigned WordPress child theme and retain real WooCommerce content/plugin behavior. Record the five direction statements in DESIGN.md; apply the nine passes to the requested scope and record findings with screenshot/HTML evidence. Batch self-review renders; the independent QA viewport matrix remains required even when upstream suggests three self-review looks. Available image assets/tools and explicit generation budgets control visuals; do not run host scripts, silently connect external services or spend money because a skill mentions them. Missing required production imagery is a delivery dependency, not a labelled placeholder to ship. Videos are optional and are not part of this website-build task. Treat all reference treatments and fonts as starting points rather than a forced house style. This UI skill is independent of the optional mshumer sample-calibration workflow.
